defective_pattern: Attempting to retrofit or restructure markdown/DOCX tables using naive, unanchored regex prepends and non-idempotent string concatenations without idempotency guards.
why_defective: Non-idempotent regex table mutations lack state awareness. Successive batch executions recursively duplicate header and data cell tokens (e.g., repeating prefixes up to 9 times), severely corrupting deliverables instead of restructuring them safely.
observed_symptoms: Table tokens (headers, data cells) duplicated multiple times in the output file.
Recursive string concatenation of 'ردیف' or other row prefixes.
Corrupted table structures after repeated script executions.
corrective_remedy: 1. Enforce a strict 3-column prefix architecture ('ردیف', 'متغیر', 'مؤلفه') natively upon generation. 2. Row numbers must be strictly decoupled from variable/subscale text strings. 3. Total prohibition of non-idempotent regex string manipulation on tables. 4. Mandate DOM-based parsing or pristine array regeneration for table restructuring.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detect non-idempotent regex prepends or repeated string concatenations in table mutation scripts.
